summary: Verified Nakit Akışı source integration (iteration 18). Backend pytest 7/7 PASS at /app/backend/tests/test_cashflow_source_integration.py. (1) Pre-existing ALL-scope rows confirmed: 1 AMAZON_DISBURSEMENT ~70.27 IN (NG), 2 CAPITAL_INJECTION 5000 IN, 1 CASH_DEPOSIT 5000 IN at Şirket (Genel), 2 CASH_WITHDRAWAL OUT (2500 and 5000) with category 'Kasa Çıkışı · Cari · Kasadan çıkış' and source_module='Sermaye & Kasa'. Each row carries source_module, source_id, original_amount, original_currency. (2) OWNER_WITHDRAWAL on temp store appears with stable source_id after prior contribution. (3) FBA lot (10 x $5 + $20 inbound) produces exactly 1 FBA_INVENTORY_PURCHASE OUT 50 + 1 FBA_INBOUND_SHIPPING OUT 20. (4) Current-account cash_effect=out + cash_status=completed produces exactly 1 CASH_WITHDRAWAL row; edit propagates amount; toggle cash_status pending removes row; toggle back re-creates; delete removes. (5) 3x serial GET + 6x concurrent GET all return identical row counts — no duplicates. (6) Totals: per-store and ALL scope summary.net_cash_flow == cash_in - cash_out, closing == opening + net, entries last running_balance == closing. (7) FBA manual-sale consumes FIFO but adds NO new OUT row (realized cost is P&L only). UI check at /cashflow (Tüm Mağazalar): KPIs Opening=$0.00 (source: 'Sermaye & Kasa kayıtlarından'), In=$16,070.27, Out=$7,570.00, Net=$8,500.27, Closing=$8,500.27 (consistent: 16070.27-7570.00=8500.27). Body shows 'Kasadan çıkış' rows with 'Çıkış' badge and source label 'Sermaye & Kasa · Kasa Çıkışı'. All test data (TEST_CF_SRC_* store, lot, capital, person, current entries) cleaned up; also cleaned up iter17 leftover TEST_CAP_UI stores that were not torn down last iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: cashflow.py section 6 (kasa_move + company_current_entries loop at line 273) correctly emits one CASH_DEPOSIT/CASH_WITHDRAWAL cash-flow row per current-account entry when cash_status=completed and cash_effect in (in,out). Stable idem_key='CASH_WITHDRAWAL:<entry_id>' guarantees upsert; toggling cash_status to pending removes the key from desired{} and the stale sweep (line 311-315) deletes the row.

FBA_INVENTORY_PURCHASE and FBA_INBOUND_SHIPPING are only emitted from fba_lots (section 1, lines 148-158). No OUT row is produced during FIFO allocation on sales — FIFO cost stays in /dashboard & /portfolio P&L via fba_allocations only. Manual-sale verified: no new cash-out rows appear.

Running-balance invariant holds end-to-end: entries['rows'][-1]['running_balance'] == entries['closing_cash'] == summary['closing_cash'] == summary['opening_cash'] + summary['net_cash_flow']. Verified both per-store and ALL scope.

Prior iteration 17 left two stale TEST_CAP_UI_* stores with CAPITAL_INJECTION entries — teardown ran but store DELETE may have been short-circuited; iter18 teardown now sorts capital deletions withdrawal-first and also drains cap_entries for the store before deleting stores.
